title: agents/marketplace
summary: Audit record and design notes for the hyprn-agents Claude Code plugin marketplace, covering the Slack channel plugin and rejected community candidates.
notes: Type set by MANIFEST_TYPE (DOC); manifest_override is true. The content is an audit record that includes a decision (own Slack server at plugins/slack/server.py) and requirements taken from ADR-0001 section 6. These are present for the synthesizer, but the manifest type DOC was kept as authoritative. Output filename is README-agents-marketplace-nohash.json rather than README-<sha8>.json: no shell or hashing tool was available to compute the SHA-256 of the source path, and README-nohash.json already holds the sibling classification for hyprn-platform/README.md, so this name was chosen to avoid overwriting it. Rename to README-<first 8 hex of sha256('agents/marketplace/README.md')>.json once the hash is available.
